facts.text: Manhattan Community Board 5 encompasses the neighborhoods of Flatiron, Herald Square, Midtown, Midtown South, Times Square, and Union Square.
Bryant Park, Madison Square Park, and Union Square Park are the three primary parks located within Manhattan Community Board 5.
Manhattan Community Board 5 includes all or part of the Murray Hill, Madison Square North, and Gramercy Park historic districts.
Commercial zoning covers the vast majority of the land area within Manhattan Community Board 5 at over eighty-two percent.
Manhattan Community Board 5 spans about one point six four square miles of land in the heart of the city.
The boundaries of Manhattan Community Board 5 stretch from 14th Street in the south up to 59th Street in the north.
